|game_text=Unless your [Reflections 3] objective on table, deploy on table. [[Vader's Obsession]] may be played to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Mara is present with [[Luke (V){{!}}Luke]], each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1). Add character's ability. If Karrde on table, your total is -1. Higher total wins. If Luke loses, place him out of play and you may retrieve 5 Force. If Mara loses, cross her to the Light Side (she is now Mara Skywalker). After the duel (unless it was canceled or tied) Mara is ability = 6, adds one battle destiny, and once per battle involving her, may cancel one just drawn destiny.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Deep Hatred (V)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image here is the Master List slip ([[:File:VB4-36-Deep_Hatred-PC-E3-master-list.png]]). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes. How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' ([[Deep Hatred (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 36)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found), page 4, slip 36. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Unless your [Reflections 3] objective on table, deploy on table. Vader's Obsession may be played to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Mara is present with Luke, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1). Add character's ability. If Karrde on table, your total is -1. Higher total wins. If Luke loses, place him out of play and you may retrieve 5 Force. If Mara loses, cross her to the Light Side (she is now Mara Skywalker). After the duel (unless it was canceled or tied) Mara is ability = 6, adds one battle destiny, and once per battle involving her, may cancel one just drawn destiny.” The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “36” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Deep Hatred (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) capitalised “Objective” and changed “After the duel (unless it was canceled or tied) Mara is ability = 6” to “Unless duel canceled or tied, for remainder of game any Mara is ability = 6”: “Unless your [Reflections 3] Objective on table, deploy on table. Vader's Obsession may be played to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Mara is present with Luke, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1). Add character's ability. If Karrde on table, your total is -1. Higher total wins. If Luke loses, place him out of play and you may retrieve 5 Force. If Mara loses, cross her to the Light Side (she is now Mara Skywalker). Unless duel canceled or tied, for remainder of game any Mara is ability = 6, adds one battle destiny, and once per battle involving her, may cancel one just drawn destiny.”<ref name="cl-1240_37-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013)</ref> The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Deep Hatred (V) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-deephatred-pre.gif]]) prints a wording of its own: “Unless your [Reflections 3] objective on table, deploy on table. Vader's Obsession may be played to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Mara is present with Luke, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1). Add character's ability. If Karrde on table, your total is -1. Higher total wins. If Luke loses, place him out of play and you may retrieve 5 Force. If Mara loses, cross her to the Light Side (she is now Mara Skywalker). Mara is ability = 6, adds one battle destiny, and once per battle involving her, may cancel one just drawn destiny.” '''What changed:''' “Unless duel canceled or tied, for remainder of game any Mara is ability = 6” becomes plain “Mara is ability = 6” (no condition: neither the card list's “Unless duel canceled or tied, for remainder of game any Mara” nor the sheet's “After the duel (unless it was canceled or tied)”), and “Objective” again has a small o. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual4-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in the folder, as last modified on 25 February 2013 (Apache directory listing, Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019<ref name="r6-Virtual4-Dark">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034634/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual4-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>), so it was made by then; the date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier (the PC card directory linked an image of this card from 2009, but no copy of those bytes survives); following Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026, it is dated by the upload date, 25 February 2013: after the card list and before the Master List. The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture, and prints the slip number “36” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 34)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=34, page 34. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=34 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Unless your [Reflections 3] objective on table, deploy on table. Vader's Obsession may be played to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Mara is present with Luke, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1). Add character's ability. If Karrde on table, your total is -1. Higher total wins. If Luke loses, place him out of play and you may retrieve 5 Force. If Mara loses, cross her to the Light Side (she is now Mara Skywalker). After the duel (unless it was canceled or tied) Mara is ability = 6, adds one battle destiny, and once per battle involving her, may cancel one just drawn destiny.” '''What changed:''' “After the duel (unless it was canceled or tied)” returns before “Mara is ability = 6”. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip is the lower part of the card, as on the release sheet; it prints no slip number at bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “36”). GEMP's current card plays this text: only the Mara who dueled gets the bonuses, and only after a duel that was not canceled or tied (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
